results.name: effects carry their command's fields: text speaker, portrait, lines; music role
a once page never runs twice: the opening has no page left
a choice hides options whose condition fails, keeps original indexes, and names the cancel option
choosing Yes: the side quest is accepted, talked is set, and the main quest settles from arrive to key on the way out
step refuses while a choice is waiting, and so does start; resolve refuses without a battle
choosing a hidden option is refused and the choice stays open
choosing Later adds to the counter and carries on past the choice
branch: giving the ring back sets kind, closes the ring group, and takes gil down to 0, never below
branch: the other outcome is then refused with an error effect and writes nothing, and the run carries on to done
branch: keeping it instead sets greedy and gives the ring
pages move with the quest: after done, the elder says thank you
a step event with no passing page runs nothing
the boss: music, sfx, then the battle waits with canLose false and canEscape true
win: chapter two flag and ship set silently, items stack to 999 and no further, then the map change and the ship
the chapter follows its bound flag: chapter two now, and the main quest settles boss to exit (completeFlag set)
entering a stage applies its sets (boss sets count to 1)
lose with no lose list is game over: the run ends, nothing after runs
escape runs the escape list and carries on
a battle outcome other than win, lose, or escape is refused and the battle still waits
settle: the side quest, accepted but not done, fails when chapter two begins, applying its fail sets
callEvent runs the callee's active page (once), then returns: move, face, text, wait, takeItem, else branch
called again, the once page has run, so page zero shows through
a call cycle (A calls B calls A) is refused with an error effect, and the rest still runs
questStage: skipping ahead applies every skipped stage's sets; moving back is refused; failing a complete quest is refused
the finale: an all condition picks the good ending; nothing after an ending runs; the game is over
without kind, the plain ending
only one event runs at a time; step with nothing running is idle
the playtester can force a page; a page that is not there is refused
a state paused mid cutscene is plain JSON: copied through JSON and resumed in another context, it finishes the same
addFlag clamps to the flag's range
quests.settle on its own chains exitWhen across stages and reports each move
save slots: one per quest and one per event with once pages, structural, sorted
round trip: 7 states through Day 146's flags list and back, in another context, identical
the flags list is [{flg, value}] whole numbers, sorted, defaults left out, quest packed
a start gate set back to 0 survives the round trip (saves start from defaults, not a new game)
a failed quest and an accepted branch pack and unpack
toSave refuses mid event and after an ending; fromSave takes party members as objects
save limits: 255 stages, 22 branch groups, once pages 0 to 30
a whole playthrough replays byte for byte in two vm contexts (effects, state hashes, final state, saved flags)
the four continent fixture: 14 gate keys bound, 6 chapters, same index and playthrough in two contexts
